anomalies.description: The central man is held at gunpoint by an unseen assailant while seated and unable to flee, constituting coercion and threat of lethal force against a restrained individual—meeting the definition of abuse (attacking a helpless victim).

A handgun is visibly pointed directly at the central man's head from off-screen; the gun is held steadily in frame f4–f6, with clear barrel and grip visible, and the central man reacts with focused alarm. This constitutes visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting.

A black handgun is visibly pressed against the right temple of the man in the brown jacket (left), held by the man in the grey suit (right). The barrel and grip are clearly visible in frames f10 and f11.
